boundary_circle_sigmas.rationale: three joint sigmas before an independent boundary circle counts as disagreeing

bounds_margin_ratio.rationale: an anchor one extent outside the part is not describing the part

curvature_dead_zone_sigmas.rationale: two estimator sigmas of curvature is indistinguishable from flat

cylinder_normal_perpendicular_deg.rationale: measured two-ring bores hold their facet normals inside five degrees

directional_bin_sigmas.rationale: four standard errors over two adjacent bins is structure, not luck

heldout_ratio_max.rationale: far outside the concentration of a correct model, immediate for an overfit one

max_axis_sigma_deg.rationale: an axis uncertain by more than two degrees makes coaxiality unlicensable

max_fillet_arc_deg.rationale: a bore or a boss closes on itself; an edge round never sweeps past a half turn

max_fillet_radius_rel_spread.rationale: a constant-radius round is constant; two percent is radius wobble

max_radius_ratio.rationale: a radius beyond five extents is the near-flat-strip pathology

max_radius_rel_sigma.rationale: a radius uncertain by more than two percent cannot drive a dimension

max_relative_residual.rationale: two percent of the sampled extent is the residual gate this skill already uses

max_triangles.rationale: the density above which extra triangles are noise samples, not information

min_angular_span_deg.rationale: below sixty degrees of arc the radius is not determined by the data

min_axial_span_ratio.rationale: half a radius of length before an axis direction means anything

min_covered_area_fraction.rationale: this run measures detection, so coverage is reported and never gated

min_cylinder_normal_directions_per_turn.rationale: a tessellated circle carries one normal direction per facet; at eight per turn a facet already spans 45 degrees, coarser than any exporter's chord tolerance, so below it the group is a prism of planar walls whose corners happen to lie on the circle

min_feature_size.rationale: the smallest fillet and bore an organiser of this family carries is one millimetre

min_normal_axis_eigengap.rationale: a twentieth of the normal spectrum away from the axis is a full ring

min_plane_aspect.rationale: a footprint narrower than one in twenty does not fix a normal about its long axis

min_sphere_occupancy.rationale: half a sphere's diameter of extent before it is a sphere

min_taper_ratio.rationale: below one percent taper a cone is a cylinder and should be reported as one

min_torus_major_ratio.rationale: a major radius under 1.2 tubes is a spindle, not a fillet

moran_baseline_slack.rationale: how far above the part's own best plane another feature may sit

moran_z_max.rationale: scanner noise is itself mildly correlated, so the iid null is conservative-false

normal_alpha_deg.rationale: loose on purpose: the normal check separates surfaces, it does not re-segment

normal_sigma_theta_floor_deg.rationale: double precision over a millimetre part leaves a microdegree

parsimony_alpha.rationale: a richer primitive must clear one percent to earn its extra parameters

regime.rationale: let the mesh's own dihedral distribution and measured sigma decide, and report which

tessellation_sigma_over_extent.rationale: an exporter's vertices sit on the analytic surface to float precision

vertex_precision_rel.rationale: a binary STL stores float32, so a vertex is quantized to a ten-millionth

weld_tolerance.rationale: exported from a solid modeller, so exact duplicates are the only duplicates
